name: Jotham
overview: The name Jotham appears in Scripture referring to distinct individuals with significant roles. Jotham, the youngest son of Gideon (Jerubbaal), survived his brothers' massacre and boldly rebuked the Shechemites with a parable from Mount Gerizim, pronouncing God's judgment on their evil deeds. Another Jotham, son of Azariah and king of Judah, is noted for his piety during a morally compromised period in Israel, and he is part of the Messianic lineage leading to Jesus. These accounts highlight themes of faithful witness amid adversity and God's sovereign justice.
